about.heading: A Trusted Catering Company in Gandhidham
body: Olive Catering Company started in 2023 in Adipur with a simple idea: vegetarian food that tastes like home, presented the way a special day deserves.

Our chefs cook traditional recipes with modern presentation, and our trained hospitality staff and supervisors look after every counter and every guest, from intimate family functions to large weddings.

faq.q: Does Olive Catering Company provide pure veg catering?
faq.a: Yes. Everything Olive Catering Company cooks is pure vegetarian. Pure veg is at the heart of every menu we serve, for weddings, corporate events and family celebrations.

faq.q: Does Olive Catering Company provide Jain catering?
faq.a: Yes. Olive Catering Company prepares Jain menus for weddings, family functions and other events, cooked without onion, garlic or root vegetables.

faq.q: Who are the wedding caterers in Gandhidham?
faq.a: Olive Catering Company is a pure veg and Jain wedding caterer based in Adipur, Gandhidham. Since 2023 it has catered weddings and family celebrations with buffet setups, live counters and trained hospitality staff.

faq.q: Does Olive provide corporate catering in Gandhidham?
faq.a: Yes. Olive Catering Company caters corporate lunches, meetings, launches and staff events in Gandhidham, with pure veg menus and Jain options.

faq.q: Where does Olive Catering Company provide catering services?
faq.a: Olive Catering Company is based in Adipur and caters events in Gandhidham and nearby towns in Kutch, including Anjar, Bhuj, Mundra and Kandla.

faq.q: Can Olive customise a wedding catering menu?
faq.a: Yes. Olive Catering Company plans each wedding menu around your family's preferences, functions and guest count, including Jain dishes and live counters.

faq.q: How can I get a catering quotation from Olive?
faq.a: Fill in the enquiry form on the website, or message Olive Catering Company on WhatsApp with your event date, type of event and approximate number of guests. The team will call you back with menu ideas and a quote.

faq.q: How early should I book wedding catering?
faq.a: Booking lead time to be confirmed by Olive.

faq.q: Is Olive Catering Company's kitchen certified?
faq.a: Yes. Olive Catering Company is FSSAI licensed (licence no. 10724013000075) and its central kitchen follows HACCP practices.
